name: Build SHYFR
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Rozpakuj projekt
        run: |
          ZIP=$(ls -t SHYFR*.zip | head -n1)
          echo "Używam: $ZIP"
          unzip -q -o "$ZIP"
          test -f SHYFR/app/build.gradle.kts

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Licencje Android SDK
        shell: bash {0}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$ANDROID_HOME/licenses"
          echo -e "\n24333f8a63b6825ea9c5514f83c2829b004d1fee" > "$ANDROID_HOME/licenses/android-sdk-license"
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null
          exit 0

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.9

      - name: Zbuduj APK
        shell: bash
        working-directory: SHYFR
        run: gradle assembleDebug --console=plain --warning-mode=none 2>&1 | tee build.log

      - name: BLEDY (krotkie podsumowanie)
        if: failure()
        shell: bash {0}
        working-directory: SHYFR
        run: |
          echo "=== BLEDY KOMPILACJI ==="
          grep -E '^e: |error:|AAPT|Could not|Unresolved|FAILED' build.log | head -60
          echo "=== CO POSZLO NIE TAK ==="
          sed -n '/What went wrong/,/^\* Try/p' build.log | head -30
          exit 0

      - name: Przygotuj plik APK
        run: cp SHYFR/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk SHYFR-debug.apk

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shyfr-debug-apk
          path: SHYFR-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
